baseline: Exact worktree source when this experiment began; includes user crnext rename and truthy bitmask checks. Not the historical unrolled baseline.
selected: segment; final differs only in explanatory comments and bundles are byte-identical

validation.paddedOriginalCapacityAssertion: Failed only on an out-of-range row accessor: padding caused earlier capacity growth. Padded passed geometry/normalization after removing that capacity assertion. Bounded/reserved/segment passed the original exact-capacity assertion.
